d:
In Madhubani, approximately 10 kathas of government land—part of the Collectorate premises—along with a two-story building, are set to be auctioned. The bidding is scheduled for November 26. The reason: the government owes Rs 4.17 crore to a private company. Now, the question arises: how will the government—which demands accountability from others—settle its own dues?
Production: Supriya
Video Editor: Gagan Deep Singh
